snippet.title: Untapped Trailer
snippet.description:
"Untapped": A co-op cooking roguelite where every run is a fresh new challenge. Team up with friends to serve impatient customers, using cards to unlock new recipes and upgrades! Adapt and improve your kitchen on the fly as the challenge ramps up.

Wishlist now on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620210/Untapped
